description: Decompose a node into a detailed node and return the updated VGL document. Only a node whose type has a detailing can be decomposed; `describe_notation` lists them. The node keeps its id, type, label and attributes and becomes a group holding new details, one per edge, so every edge keeps its id and label and now ends at a detail. Rename and retype the new details afterwards.

node.description: Id of the node to decompose

vgl.description: The VGL document holding the node

name: decompose
